youtube.title: Hot Cross Buns 🥯 Count 1, 2 and Share Sing-Along for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Hot Cross Buns with Robo the baker and learn to count and share! Ding! A tray of hot cross buns comes out of the oven. Count them, one, two, then knock, knock: guess which friend is at the door by the sound. Every friend shares the two buns with Robo, one each, and we ask: is it fair? Watch out for Bear, who takes two! Then a point-to-it quiz and the whole song with everyone.

What your child learns: counting one and two, sharing one each, and what "fair" means (the same for you and the same for me).

Sing at home: hold up one finger, then two, on "one a penny, two a penny", share two snacks with a friend or a teddy, one each, and ask "Is it fair?". The first verse of Hot Cross Buns is a traditional public-domain rhyme sung to its traditional tune; the sharing verse ("If you have a friend, share one with your friend") and the story are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
